intro: Solano Grand is an executive condominium at Senja Close, in District 23. City Developments Limited’s SGX operational update for the first quarter of 2026, as recorded in our project file, lists a 302-unit EC at Senja Close and an expected launch in the first quarter of 2027. The name Solano Grand is recorded from subsequent reporting of a CDL briefing. Tenure is listed as 99 years. The launch window is a developer expectation and may change. Agent-site booking dates are unofficial and are not used here. TOP is not officially confirmed, and typologies are not in our file. This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your Solano Grand renovation.

sections.heading: Planning your Solano Grand interior
sections.text:
Senja Close sits in the Bukit Panjang side of District 23, in the same wider catchment as Dairy Farm, Hillview and Bukit Batok. An EC in this belt is typically a long-stay family home, so the first interior is worth specifying as built-in work rather than as a temporary arrangement of loose furniture. The pieces that usually do the job are an entry cabinet, a living-room joinery wall, full-height wardrobes, and a fitted kitchen with a tall pantry. If a common bedroom will be a study, a built-in desk and wardrobe on one wall is the cleaner answer. Maison designs that carpentry professionally, including closer material photographs when you need to decide on a finish, and we do not use IKEA-style flat-pack furniture as the main look.

No official floor plan is on file, so typologies and room sizes are not listed. Nearby Maison pages include The Myst, Lumina Grand, Altura, Narra Residences and The Botany at Dairy Farm, all in the District 23 or Bukit Batok belt. Use them as internal links. Do not assume they share a layout or a management handbook with Solano Grand. We will not invent walking times to Bukit Panjang, to Senja, or to any MRT station.

If you are watching a Q1 2027 launch, you can talk to us once a unit type and a plan are available; there is no need to brief a designer from marketing language alone. After keys, the sequence remains defects, measurement, renovation approval, then fabrication. A moderate carpentry scope is often planned at six to ten weeks on site after approvals, as an editorial figure only. We are not affiliated with CDL. WhatsApp Maison when you have a plan to share.

faq.q: When is the Solano Grand launch?
faq.a: Our project file records: 2027-Q1 planned launch. That is a developer expectation and may change. It is not a TOP or a key date.

faq.q: Is the TOP date for Solano Grand confirmed?
faq.a: No. TOP is not officially confirmed in our file. We have left any unofficial booking or e-application dates out.

faq.q: Do you have the Solano Grand floor plan?
faq.a: No official floor-plan or site image is on file for this page, so none is published here. Please send your approved unit plan.

faq.q: Can I renovate right after keys?
faq.a: After handover, inspect defects and obtain the management corporation’s renovation approval first. A moderate carpentry scope is often planned at about six to ten weeks on site after access and approvals; that is an editorial allowance, not a guarantee.
Your approved floor plan, unit type if you have it, and a key date if one is already in writing. WhatsApp us at https://wa.me/6593391185.
